title: Associated points of flat pullback over a locally Noetherian scheme
statement:
Let $h:Y\to Z$ be a flat morphism of schemes [def-weil-flat-morphism], with $Z$ locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth], and let $\mathcal G$ be any quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_Z$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. For a module $\mathcal H$ on a scheme $W$, write $\operatorname{Ass}_W(\mathcal H)$ for the points whose stalk maximal ideal is the annihilator of an element of $\mathcal H_w$, as in [def-trf-relative-assassin]. For $z\in Z$, let $Y_z$ be the scheme-theoretic fibre [def-pc-scheme-fibre] and $j_z:Y_z\to Y$ its projection. Then, as subsets of $Y$,
$$\operatorname{Ass}_Y(h^*\mathcal G)=\bigcup_{z\in\operatorname{Ass}_Z(\mathcal G)}j_z\bigl(\operatorname{Ass}_{Y_z}(\mathcal O_{Y_z})\bigr).$$
Here $h^*$ is pullback of modules [def-pc-module-pullback]. No finite-type hypothesis on $\mathcal G$, and no local Noetherianity hypothesis on $Y$, is imposed.
